items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: in the band was Kid Ory, Barney Bigard, Charlie Beal, Bud Scott and myself

ctx.x: It's a classic film. I've seen it. I'd forgotten who was on piano.

And jumping ahead to 1947 (which I seem to be good at jumping around) was another film that I enjoyed doing. This was with Louis Armstrong, also Billie Holiday, and Barney Bigard, Kid Ory, the guitar player Bud Scott,
